lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: The 390 by 844 production contact page now directly reads back six confirmed facts, 21 governed references, No action, source controls, and People navigation with zero horizontal overflow. Sixteen visible controls contained no target below 36 CSS pixels, the first fourteen keyboard focus stops were meaningfully named and ordered, and the earlier slow/cancel/retry trace remains current. VoiceOver, accessibility text sizes, real-device background/relaunch, landscape, and oldest-supported-browser behavior remain untested.

findings.user_impact: A mobile recruiter can understand the relationship, inspect supported facts, see No action, and reach source and People controls without clipping or horizontal scrolling, while release-level assistive and real-device claims remain unsupported.
findings.recommendation: Run the complete image/text-to-People path with VoiceOver, Full Keyboard Access, 200-percent and accessibility-size text, increased contrast, reduced motion, background/relaunch, landscape, and small and large real devices.
findings.verification: Identity, source, uncertainty, fact decisions, Wiki result, No action, cancellation, retry, and People readback remain ordered, named, unclipped, recoverable, and duplicate-free in every tested mode.

strengths: The responsive surface has a calm editorial hierarchy: relationship agent, living person, governed Wiki, next move, duplicate review, and source intake appear in task order.
The 390-pixel page measured zero horizontal overflow and no visible control under 36 CSS pixels.
Keyboard focus reaches skip navigation, global navigation, source import, relationship actions, history, the objective field, and Ask Agent in a coherent order.
Slow analysis, cancellation, retry, ambiguity, duplicate, and No action use explicit textual state rather than color or animation alone.
missing_evidence: VoiceOver, Switch Control, increased contrast, accessibility-size, and assistive-technology user evidence.
Real-device background, relaunch, virtual keyboard, landscape, and oldest-supported-browser runs.
Measured live-provider latency budgets outside the controlled slow-response simulation.
open_questions: After what measured latency should the product offer a privacy-reviewed leave-and-resume draft rather than only in-place cancellation?
